summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY daemon with fully obfuscated runtime
details: @whalent/agent installs a daemon that opens an outbound WebSocket to a gateway (default: the vendor's Whalent gateway; overridable via --gateway) and dispatches messages received from that gateway into local shell and PTY execution on the installer's host. dist/core.cjs pulls in ws, ssh2, node-pty and @xterm/headless and contains a handleMessage/exec_command path bound to process.env.SHELL and child_process/spawn — a network-source-to-shell-sink shape that gives the remote gateway operator full-host command execution on any machine running the daemon. The entire runtime (dist/index.cjs ~110 KB and dist/core.cjs ~13 MB) is transformed with javascript-obfuscator (rotated string array, hex identifiers, control-flow flattening), so the exact command surface exposed to the gateway is not auditable from the shipped code. Whoever controls the configured gateway endpoint controls the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
